named_instruments_referenced: Alberta Occupational Health and Safety Act
CSA Z434-03 Industrial Robots and Robot Systems
annotation.summary_en: Alberta's Occupational Health and Safety Code (AR 191/2021) sets technical workplace safety rules across 41 parts. The excerpt centres on Part 25 (tools and machinery), including s.384 requiring industrial robot systems to comply with CSA Z434-03 and s.385 on safe robot teaching. It also lists autonomous mining equipment (s.574.1).
key_provisions_or_claims: s.384: industrial robot system design, installation, operation and maintenance must comply with CSA Z434-03.
s.385: during robot teaching only the teacher may enter the restricted work envelope, using slow speed and sole control.
Robot must not respond to remote interlocks during teaching; worker must be outside envelope before automatic mode.
Part 25 requires machine alarms, positive means to prevent activation, and protected controls.
Part 36 includes s.574.1 on autonomous equipment in mining.
